versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of the dataify-google-map-details skill.

- Submit Google Maps detail collection tasks using Dataify Builder for URL, CID, location, or place ID modes.
- Guides the user through choosing a collection mode and entering relevant parameters with validation and default values.
- Handles API TOKEN setup, including local environment variable saving upon user confirmation.
- Supports multiple group submission per mode, with clear parameter table instructions.
- Provides guidance throughout the workflow and directs users to the Dataify dashboard for task results.
